answer: Resist Sybils with a heartbeat pulse: every epoch, each identity must answer a short, unpredictable liveness challenge within a tight window, proving a live operator is behind it. Passing earns only a single-epoch token that cannot be stockpiled or transferred, so a farmer must keep dozens of fakes awake and responsive at all hours, paying full attention per identity, which makes mass fakery exhausting and unprofitable.
